title: Gemini client -> OpenAI upstream (openai-compatibility provider)

gateway.auth: x-goog-api-key: <gateway-api-key> OR Authorization: Bearer <gateway-api-key>; concrete key: oracle-local-key-1 (config api-keys[0]); header value is a placeholder in this file, never a real secret

upstream.config: name "mock-openai", base-url http://host.docker.internal:18999/v1, api-key mock-upstream-key, model name mock-gpt-model, alias mock-model (already in run/config.yaml)

mock_extension_request.what: mock_openai.py gains a 'scenario' control key (from mock/control/openai.json or X-Mock-Scenario header); scenarios are exact canned responses listed below; modes happy/error/slow/disconnect keep their current semantics ON TOP of the selected scenario; with no scenario set the CURRENT default behavior must remain byte-identical (old S2-mock recordings must stay reproducible).
mock_extension_request.note: All scenario bodies/frames are byte-exact; send them verbatim (json.dumps compact, no spaces).

recording_contract.per_case: tests/fixtures/S2d2/<case-id>/{meta.yaml,request.http,downstream.md,upstream.jsonl,mock-response.json}; multi-request cases: label each request (R1..Rn) in request.http and each response in downstream.md in order (or use per-request suffixed files and note the layout in meta.yaml)
record_always: downstream status + full response headers + exact body bytes (or full SSE byte stream incl. framing newlines)
upstream-side received request(s): method, path, headers (secrets redacted), exact body bytes (from mock logs/openai.jsonl, delimited per case)
the scripted mock reply that drove the case (mock-response.json)

ordering_constraints: Run order recommendation: cases 1-13, 16 (happy/slow/disconnect), then 14-15 (error/cooldown) LAST.
Cases 14 and 15 leave the mock-model credential in rate-limit cooldown for ~1s: after them, wait >= 1s (or restart) before any other mock-model case.
Case 15 request B MUST fire immediately (< 1s) after its request A to catch the cooldown window.
Snap the mock wire log (or note offsets) per case so upstream.jsonl attribution is unambiguous.
